description: Defines the OrderService interface with methods related to order management such as creating, deleting, verifying payments, and retrieving order data.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order based on the provided OrderRequest.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes the order identified by the given orderId.

methods.name: getLatestOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of the most recent orders.

methods.name: verifyPayment
methods.description: Verifies payment using the provided PaymentVerificationRequest.

methods.name: sumSalesByDate
methods.description: Calculates total sales for a given date.

methods.name: countByOrderDate
methods.description: Counts the number of orders on a specified date.
